security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Dynodoc: version control for documents, on your computer
bundle.longDescription: Dynodoc keeps Word, Excel and PowerPoint files under version control: history, drafts, change requests and reviews. The workspace lives on this computer (a database and the engine start with the app, no server needed); sign in to a Dynodoc server to sync a project, and use your own model provider for the agent.
